implementedChanges.change: Removed bounded Thread.SpinWait from ClearActiveLockBitIfUnused; added O(1) numeric contention telemetry; split release gate from acquire gate so releases can clear already-held locks without compaction-fence wait.
Hoisted template descriptor and loot payload construction outside OrganicTemplateDescriptors/OrganicLootEntries locks; locked section now clears and copies prebuilt struct arrays.
Added editor-only NUnit fail-closed contention proof for 10,000 TryAcquireWriteLock failures with zero thread-local allocation assertion.

Added fixed-size unmanaged deferred-release ring. ReleaseWriteLock/TryUnlockBuffer now queue release requests when the mutation gate is busy; the next legal mutation-gate entrant drains the ring before continuing. No spin, sleep, allocation, or public API change.
QueueDeferredRelease coalesces identical pending deferred-release records before claiming a slot.
implementedChanges.reason: prevents duplicate caller retries from double-decrementing writer/buffer-pin lock counters

implementedChanges.change: QueueDeferredRelease coalesces duplicate writer-release records only; buffer-pin releases stay count-preserving.
implementedChanges.reason: prevents writer retry double-release without collapsing multiple legitimate buffer pins

implementedChanges.change: Contended release methods return QueueDeferredRelease result instead of unconditional false.
implementedChanges.reason: accepted deferred release transfers release responsibility to the vault and discourages caller retries

implementedChanges.change: Added TryDrainDeferredReleaseRequests and invoked it before defrag/arena active-lock checks.
implementedChanges.reason: prevents accepted deferred releases from starving defrag/growth paths that check active locks before entering mutation gate

implementedChanges.change: TryEnterBlockMutationGate and TryEnterReleaseMutationGate now release the mutation gate if deferred-release drain faults before returning ownership to the caller.
implementedChanges.reason: prevents editor/runtime container-check exceptions inside drain from leaving _blockMutationGate permanently held

implementedChanges.change: TryOpenAliasBuffer contention on TryEnterBlockMutationGate now records numeric lock contention fault instead of dumping PhiVod black-box files.
